artifact.format: PE32+ AMD64 DLL despite archive member .exe suffix
artifact.role: Publisher-reported BLOODALCHEMY supporting loader in a VAPOR PANDA campaign using ARTEX; not an ARTEX framework executable

reconstruction.scope: All functions in this finite import inventory, including runtime/library routines. This is not proof of no undiscovered code, correct recovered types or complete behavioral understanding. Detailed operand review is limited to the named functions.

facts.value: graphics-hook_config.bin: 16-byte AES-128 key prefix followed by CBC ciphertext with an all-zero 16-byte initial IV
facts.scope: Exact retained loader only; supplied encrypted payload was not acquired. Expected well-formed block-aligned data; no actual payload key or plaintext recovered.

native_locators.meaning: Key schedule called with original input pointer
Original ciphertext block becomes next IV at context+0xb0

facts.method: Reviewed round-key expansion, inverse substitutions/row shifts/mix columns and CBC feedback. Own inert translation using extracted tables matched an independent installed cryptography AES-CBC reference on six synthetic inputs; no artifact code or actual payload was run.
facts.decoder_boundary: The wrapper moves the decrypted body back over the 16-byte prefix; it does not itself reveal a configured endpoint.

facts.value: host module base+0x1000: 12-byte mov-rax/jmp-rax redirection to the loader; sibling graphics-hook_config.bin read/decoded; decoded buffer passed as EnumDateFormatsW callback
facts.scope: Conditional static code paths only. Native syscall helper intervenes before the callback call. Successful dispatch, victim execution and full downstream payload behavior are not established.

native_locators.meaning: First VirtualProtect call; 12 bytes and PAGE_READWRITE
First instruction encoding stored at destination
EnumDateFormatsW call, callback points to processed buffer; import at0x18000c058

facts.host_entrypoint_qualification: The patch uses fixed module+0x1000, not a parsed AddressOfEntryPoint. The separately retained legitimate GameHook reference has PE entry RVA0x1e04; do not label this a proven PE-entrypoint patch.

limitations: No new malicious C2, sample-configured endpoint, victim execution or live operation was established.
Patterns are sample-specific software/capability observations at score20; production detection specificity was not measured.
No original sample, reconstructed native C/ASM, project, credentials or crypto secret is published.
